Our Mission

At Elementary, we're building trust in data and AI at scale. We provide data observability and quality monitoring that catches issues before they impact decisions or AI outputs, so teams can move fast with confidence.

Who We Are

Elementary is redefining how organizations trust and use data in the AI era. We're a fast-growing, well-funded startup working with enterprise customers while powering thousands of data teams through our open-source platform. We're a hybrid, globally-minded team based in Tel Aviv, working closely with users and customers worldwide.
